telc C2 Exam: Integrated Tasks, Scoring and Preparation

Understand telc Deutsch C2: integrated listening and writing, exam timings, pass thresholds, official practice material and advanced preparation steps.

telc Deutsch C2 · Source checked 14 November 2026

See the exam formatOfficial mock and sources

Choose the correct examination

This guide covers general telc Deutsch C2. It includes an integrated listening-and-writing subtest and is not a relabelled version of Goethe C2 GDS. Advanced preparation needs to follow this particular task structure.

Exam format and timing

Published task times; arrival, breaks and appointment length are separate.
PartTask timeWhat to check
Reading80 minutesThree parts; the structure table lists a 20-minute break.
Listening and writing60 minutes combinedOne integrated subtest: listening information must be processed in writing.
Writing90 minutesOne separate writing subtest.
SpeakingAbout 15 minutesUsually one candidate; 20 minutes of preparation.

These are the published standard task times, not a promise of total appointment length. Follow the centre’s instructions for your booked format, breaks and any approved accommodations.

Scoring and partial examinations

The officially linked mock lists 160 points overall. A certificate requires at least 72 written points and 24 oral points, adding to at least 96. Do not combine independent Goethe module marks or import the C1 scale.

The product page permits partial examinations. Confirm the current written/oral credit rules and available format with the centre; partial booking does not mean each named subtest is separately bookable.

Switching from Goethe C2?

Goethe C2 has four modules, with listening separate from writing, and normally 15 minutes of speaking preparation. telc C2 includes a 60-minute integrated listening/writing subtest and lists 20 minutes of oral preparation.

Read the Goethe C2 guide before transferring a study plan between providers.

Prepare each skill

Reading

Train dense argument, implicit meaning and precise distinctions between close alternatives. When reviewing, explain why the text supports one interpretation and excludes another rather than citing one matching keyword.

Listening and writing

Practise turning a longer spoken argument into accurate, structured notes and then a coherent written response. Separate what the speaker said from your own inference; do not fill a missing detail with a plausible invention.

Writing

Develop an extended, clearly structured response with precise vocabulary and consistent register. Edit for ambiguous references, unsupported claims and paraphrases that accidentally strengthen the source statement.

Speaking

Rehearse an individual contribution followed by a challenging exchange. Practise qualifying your position, answering a counterexample and returning to the question without relying on ornate memorised phrases.

Build a preparation sequence

The following is Klarweg’s study advice, not an official schedule or a promise that a set number of weeks produces this level. Adjust the sequence after a diagnostic attempt.

  1. Map the integrated task. Attempt the official listening/writing subtest and trace each important statement in your response back to the audio or your notes.
  2. Improve control. Compare two drafts for accuracy, structure and register. Remove details that sound sophisticated but are unsupported or irrelevant.
  3. Rehearse endurance. Complete the published blocks with the stated break and prepare an individual speaking contribution within 20 minutes. Seek specific feedback on precision.

Mistakes to avoid

  • Treating C2 as a vocabulary list while neglecting source-faithful synthesis.
  • Preparing only Goethe C2 literature or rewriting tasks for a telc booking.
  • Assuming a partial examination means separate booking of all four listed subtests.

Check readiness before booking

  • I can explain the integrated listening/writing task in my own words.
  • My notes distinguish source claims from my interpretation.
  • I can sustain precise extended writing under the stated time limit.
  • I have rehearsed an individual oral contribution and follow-up exchange.

Use the official answer key for objective items. For writing and speaking, compare the published criteria and seek specific feedback; an unchecked self-score is not a reliable pass prediction.

Common questions

Is there a telc C2 examination?

Yes. telc lists a general telc Deutsch C2 examination and publishes its structure and official mock material.

Is its listening section a standalone comprehension test?

The published structure includes a combined Listening and Writing subtest lasting 60 minutes. Practise the integrated task rather than substituting a Goethe listening module.

Fees, dates and your exam centre

Ask the examination centre for the current fee, available date, full examination name, delivery format, cancellation terms and identification rules. This guide does not sell places, guarantee availability or quote a nationwide fee.

Find an examination centre through telc and confirm that it offers your exact test. If a certificate is needed for admission, work or an official process, confirm acceptance with the receiving organisation.
